title: The Rabby Token Approval

captures.note: dry: stopped at the confirm screen

_comment: Selling a token (1 USDC → ETH) in Rabby's Swap, which needs an allowance. The button reads 'Approve and Swap'. On chain it is TWO transactions: approve() for EXACTLY 1 USDC (not unlimited) to AllowanceHolder 0x0000…2734 (Sourcify: AllowanceHolder), then the swap through that same contract. Quote screen labelled the route Uniswap. Before quoting, Rabby read the current allowance with eth_call through its own RPC proxy. Both txs went out via Rabby's submit_tx like R1. Approval tx 0x56ce0e031a709bea485dbf36d8f4e37ffd359c3f69c1e7c7c8e712ac9e5dbe06, swap tx 0x2528dff0b595867d4506d9102d52acc7b55b6be8a6f3e7b2fe4fe2d5e5353ab5.
